facts: Use the supplied identities of (Et2N)3P, phthalic anhydride (PA), Et3B, propylene oxide (PO), CO2 and the TFPO/ethoxide probes. For the local molecular comparison, consider complete neutral singlet free phosphine and 1:1 phosphine/PO and phosphine/PA inventories (46, 56 and 61 atoms respectively); construct and justify their molecular arrangements. Report local geometry and ADCH atomic populations for comparable gas-phase ground-state structures. Separate this molecular reference from the bulk feed [PO]/[PA]/[(Et2N)3P]/[Et3B]=2000/1/1/2 at 80 °C and initial CO2 pressure 2.0 MPa. The supplied TFPO observations concern C6D6, while the ethoxide probe uses CDCl3 after THF preparation. These are known interaction observations, not measured reaction barriers or long-chain binding energies. Bulk productivity, molecular weight, full polymerization networks and other catalyst families are outside scope.
scope: Local molecular interactions and explicitly bounded interpretations only.
